run_metadata.prototype_disclaimer: BSD is an evaluated research prototype (v0.3 Phase 2b). Statistical anomalies and detection candidates are not independently confirmed physical events.

scientific_semantics.measured_features: Raw time-domain waveform, 3-scale STFT excess power, 512-pt spectral-continuum band powers, and 31-ms broadband impulsive crest ratio.
scientific_semantics.statistical_anomalies: Windows whose raw STFT or frozen-reference broadband score exceeds the empirical calibration threshold relative to the supplied background dataset.
scientific_semantics.detection_candidates: Localized time-frequency clusters nominated in Stream A, preserved 100% verbatim alongside reversible veto annotations and orthogonal Stream B credibility warnings.
scientific_semantics.independent_physical_confirmation: NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_SINGLE_CHANNEL_WORKSTATION: Statistical anomalies and detection candidates are never proof of a physical or astrophysical event without independent multi-sensor or domain-specific confirmation.

numeric_precision: Legacy timeline/candidate numbers remain rounded; *_full_precision fields preserve the original finite decision inputs. Missing precision in legacy records is not reconstructed.
